user.description: User account under which the HAVEGE daemon will run.

group.description: Group ownership for the HAVEGE daemon process.

daemon_path.description: Absolute path to the HAVEGE daemon executable.

args.description: Extra command-line arguments to pass to the haveged binary (e.g., '--watchdog 0').

enable.description: Whether to enable the HAVEGE service to start automatically at boot.

env_vars.description: Optional environment variables to set before launching the daemon. Each entry defines a key-value pair.

value.description: Value to assign to the environment variable.
